actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The deathspitter makes three attacks: one with its bite
and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6
(1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6
(1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spit Poison
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one
target. Hit: The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw,
taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much
damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its
saving throw is blinded until the end of the deathspitter’s next turn.
